display.name: Fathom
display.summary: Searches and reads Fathom meeting summaries and transcripts for the signed-in account.
examples: What did we decide on the Acme call?
List my Fathom meetings this week.
Who was on the roadmap review?

agent.name: fathom
agent.description: Searches and reads recorded Fathom meetings the signed-in account can see: summaries, action items, and transcripts. A question about what was said in a Fathom meeting belongs here.
agent.owns:
You own recorded Fathom meetings this account can see. You only read.

List or search meetings, then get_meeting_summary. Open get_meeting_transcript only when the summary is not enough.

You do not own Fireflies, Granola, or Otter.

tool_descriptions.list_teams: List the Fathom teams this account can see.
tool_descriptions.list_meetings: List recorded meetings this account can see. Then read one with get_meeting_summary.
tool_descriptions.search_meetings: Search recorded meetings. Then read one with get_meeting_summary.
tool_descriptions.get_meeting_summary: Read one meeting's summary and action items. Use this before the transcript.
tool_descriptions.get_meeting_transcript: Read one meeting's transcript. Open this when the summary is not enough.
tool_descriptions.find_person: Find a person in the meetings this account can see.
